exposure: temporal changes in risk indicators for PPH
outcome: PPH (blood loss >1000 mL within 24 h following delivery)
cohort: The study included 2,406,784 women who gave birth in the Netherlands between January 2000 and December 2013, with births >=22 weeks of gestation.
finding: The incidence of PPH significantly increased from 4.1% in 2000 to 6.4% in 2013, which was only partly explained by the studied risk indicators, while PPH-related blood transfusions remarkably decreased.
